hold_reasoning: No new BUY fits the risk budget. Cash is EUR 221.29 against a EUR 150 floor, which leaves about EUR 71 to deploy, well below the EUR 250 minimum position. The book also already holds 7 lines against a cap of 6, counting the SLB dust. The two buy-bias notes don't change this. Sharp-shooter-eur's ADEN.SW entry is still unconfirmed: it closed at CHF 26.16, under the 26.40 trigger. World's euro-defensives thesis (SAN.PA, AI.PA, IBE.MC) is coherent at conviction 6, but there is no slot to fund it. No held thesis is breaking. 4GLD.DE at 112.48 is still inside goldfinger's 112-120 box, and the break needs a Xetra close below 110. Goldfinger's note also covers PHAG.L, and silver is held, not broken. BTC-EUR at 66,669 is above satoshi's 64.9k break line, and selling it for EUR would trigger PFU on a gain of about 14%. AIR.PA and ALV.DE are firm, and ALV is in line with world's note that Allianz is at 52-week highs. NVDA has no analyst coverage either way and no stop has been hit. No position is over the EUR 400 cap: BTC is the largest at 366.67. The SLB stub is worth EUR 0.16, so selling it would cost more in the EUR 1.25 IBIE fee floor than it raises, and the sale would be refused. I leave it. I considered a conditional stop on 4GLD.DE at 110. I passed because the trigger fires on a live price cross while the analyst's break is a daily close, so an intraday wick could exit a floor test by mistake. I'll reassess if 4GLD.DE closes below 110 or BTC closes below 64.9k. Default HOLD.
